title: osenv is no longer supported
summary: npm states that the osenv package is no longer supported.

constraints: Preserve platform-specific home, temp, editor, shell, path, and environment-variable fallback behavior actually used by the application.

steps.title: Replace operating-system environment helpers
steps.instructions: Replace each osenv helper with maintained runtime APIs and explicit environment-variable handling, then remove osenv.

verification.purpose: Run environment resolution and cross-platform repository tests.
